Show less Read more Like 25 Dislike Reply 2 replies Hide replies 2 replies @Omari3333 2 months ago Actor Michael B. Jordan is 6 feet (1.83 m) tall. His weight fluctuates depending on his film roles, but typically ranges from 175 to 190 pounds (79 to 86 kg) for his most famous action and boxing films. Height Details Jordan has confirmed his height as 6 feet on social media. This measurement is consistently cited across various sources. Weight Details Jordan undergoes significant body transformations with his trainer Corey Calliet for different roles. Creed (original film): He weighed around 175 pounds (79 kg). For Black Panther: He gained 15-20 pounds, bulking up to roughly 190-195 pounds (86-88 kg) to play Erik Killmonger. For Creed II: He cut down again, weighing approximately 190 pounds (86 kg) while achieving an extremely lean, ripped physique. For Creed III: He maintained a very muscular build, weighing around 185 pounds (84 kg) during filming. Show less Read more Like 18 Dislike Reply @Omari3333 2 months ago Lori Harvey's height is consistently reported as 5 feet 3 inches (1.6 m), though some sources list slightly different figures. Regarding her weight, she has publicly discussed her body image and fitness journey, and her weight has fluctuated. Sources indicate she generally weighs around 123 pounds (56 kg) when maintaining an ideal shape. She has mentioned that she generally fluctuates between 94 lbs to 107 lbs on a weekly basis, and her personal goal has been 120 lbs. In 2022, she shared that she lost 15 lbs of "relationship weight" to achieve her toned physique, which involved a strict diet and exercise regimen. It is important to note that Harvey has been open about her struggles with body image and has been diagnosed with PCOS and endometriosis, which can affect weight.
